g.text: - USB-C, USB ESD, 3.3 V regulation and RESET/BOOT are on the XIAO module. Its 5V pin is the USB VBUS rail; its 3V3 pin supplies this board.

g.desc: - USB-C, USB ESD, 3.3 V regulation and RESET/BOOT are on the XIAO module. Its 5V pin is the USB VBUS rail; its 3V3 pin supplies this board.

g.text: - CAN-bus 5 V enters the XIAO 5V pin through U3 (LM66100 ideal diode, CE low), as Seeed requires for external supplies: the bus is never back-fed from USB.

g.desc: - CAN-bus 5 V enters the XIAO 5V pin through U3 (LM66100 ideal diode, CE low), as Seeed requires for external supplies: the bus is never back-fed from USB.

g.text: - With USB and the CAN bus both connected, the higher of the two 5 V sources supplies the board. Max input 5.5 V.

g.desc: - With USB and the CAN bus both connected, the higher of the two 5 V sources supplies the board. Max input 5.5 V.

g.text: - +3.3VA feeds the FT5316 analog supplies (VDDA, VDD3) through FB1 to keep MCU switching noise out of the sensing front end.

g.desc: - +3.3VA feeds the FT5316 analog supplies (VDDA, VDD3) through FB1 to keep MCU switching noise out of the sensing front end.

g.text: - LEDs: D1 CAN bus power present, D3 3V3 present, D9 +3.3VA (FT5316 analog) present.

g.desc: - LEDs: D1 CAN bus power present, D3 3V3 present, D9 +3.3VA (FT5316 analog) present.

g.text: - J8: 2.54 mm debug header (+5V, +3V3, +3.3VA, GND). H1-H3 M3 NPTH; H4 M3 plated top side on GND (bolt only if chassis ground is wanted).

g.desc: - J8: 2.54 mm debug header (+5V, +3V3, +3.3VA, GND). H1-H3 M3 NPTH; H4 M3 plated top side on GND (bolt only if chassis ground is wanted).
